name: model_op_add_rms_norm
description: Element-wise add followed by RMS normalization (FlagGems-vllm PR #731, src/flaggems_vllm/runtime/backend/_ascend/ops/add_rms_norm.py::add_rms_norm). x1 and x2 [..., N] float16/bfloat16/float32 with identical shapes, normalized_shape a tuple of the trailing dimensions to normalize, weight [N] same dtype, eps float. Computes x = (x1 + x2) in float32, variance = sum(x*x/N) over the normalized dimensions, then x * rsqrt(variance + eps) * weight cast back to x1's dtype. Matches torch_npu.npu_add_rms_norm(x1, x2, weight, eps)[0]. Returns a newly allocated tensor; neither input is modified.
